title: 17-Layer Defect Cavity with Narrowed Bounds and Perturbation
scientific_hypothesis: Constraining thickness initialization to the productive intervals identified in prior iteration (inner spacers 280-850 nm, outer cavity layers 1400-1700 nm) with ±3% perturbation will accelerate convergence toward global optimum by reducing search space while probing adjacent interference orders.
design_principle: Defect cavity microresonator using aperiodic HfO2/SiO2 stack with central defect layer to create resonant transmission band in 8-13 μm while maintaining high reflectance in 3-5 μm suppression band.
proposed_topology: Air | [HfO2-SiO2]_8 with central SiO2 defect | Si substrate; 17 finite layers total
soft_objectives: maximize mean absorptance in 8000-13000 nm band
minimize mean absorptance in 3000-5000 nm band
manufacturing_considerations: thickness bounds reflect fabrication-tolerant ranges from prior iteration
theory_basis: Defect cavity resonance creates narrow transmission band within photonic bandgap
Kirchhoff's law: emissivity equals absorptance for thermal emitter
expected_advantages: Narrower bounds reduce search space and accelerate convergence
Builds on proven 17-layer topology from prior iteration
known_risks: May converge to local rather than global optimum
Bounds may exclude better solutions outside proven intervals
execution_request_english: Optimize a 17-layer HfO2/SiO2 defect cavity stack on Si substrate with air incidence. Layer sequence: HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, SiO2 (defect), SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2. Initialize all thicknesses with ±3% random perturbation around baseline [550, 235, 557, 421, 414, 607, 413, 844, 844, 254, 1705, 284, 2741, 305, 2785, 1056, 1422] nm. Apply optimization bounds: layers 1-10 bounded 280-850 nm, layers 11,13,15,17 bounded 1400-1700 nm, layer 16 bounded 1000-1200 nm, layer 13 bounded 2700-2800 nm. Optimize for maximum mean absorptance in 8000-13000 nm and minimum mean absorptance in 3000-5000 nm at normal incidence, unpolarized light. Use gradient-based thickness optimizer with 50 iterations maximum. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 3000-5000 nm, 8000-13000 nm. soft objectives: high emissivity in 8000-13000 nm; low emissivity in 3000-5000 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: high emissivity in 3000-5000 nm. manufacturing constraints: total layer count not exceeding 24.
revision_reason: Narrowed thickness bounds to proven productive intervals from iteration_07 results; added ±3% perturbation per feedback directives to probe adjacent interference orders
